# @tansy/logs-otlp

Sends the audit log and request log over OpenTelemetry (OTLP/HTTP), to Grafana, Honeycomb, Datadog, Axiom or any collector.

```bash
npm install @tansy/logs-otlp
```

Add it to `tansy.config.ts`. See [the logs-otlp plugin documentation](https://github.com/mhmdsalahsebai/tansy/blob/main/docs/plugins/logs-otlp.md) for what it adds and the options it takes.

A first-party plugin for [tansy](https://github.com/mhmdsalahsebai/tansy), a self-hosted, runtime-schema CMS for Next.js. MIT licensed.
